# BurnerDesignPro

> BurnerDesignPro is a suite of free online thermal engineering calculators for combustion, emissions, flame temperature, orifice metering and insulation design. Calculations follow ISO 6976, ISO 5167, ISO 12241, ASTM C680, EPA Method 19 and NASA Glenn thermochemical data. No signup required for basic tools.

## Calculators
- [Adiabatic Flame Temperature Calculator](https://burnerdesignpro.com/flame-temperature): Calculates adiabatic flame temperature and equilibrium product composition using NASA Glenn thermochemical coefficients and Gibbs free-energy minimization. Supports CH4, C3H8, H2, C4H10, CO, custom fuels, excess air, air preheat and humidity.
- [Pipe & Flat Insulation Calculator](https://burnerdesignpro.com/insulation-calculator): Heat loss, surface temperature, condensation control and energy savings for insulated pipes and flat surfaces per ISO 12241 and ASTM C680, with self-consistent convection/radiation iteration (Churchill-Chu, Churchill-Bernstein).
- [Orifice Plate Calculator (ISO 5167)](https://burnerdesignpro.com/orifice-calculator): Orifice plate sizing, discharge coefficient (Reader-Harris/Gallagher), differential pressure and mass flow per ISO 5167, with expansibility for compressible flow.
- [Fuel Gas Properties Manager (ISO 6976)](https://burnerdesignpro.com/fuel-manager): Calorific value (HHV/LHV), Wobbe index, density and combustion properties of natural gas and fuel gas mixtures per ISO 6976 / ASTM D4868.
- [Emission Calculator (EPA Method 19)](https://burnerdesignpro.com/emission): NOx, CO, CO2, SO2 emission rates and factors per EPA Method 19, IPCC 2006 and EU IED, mass-based and heat-input-based.
- [Combustion Efficiency Calculator](https://burnerdesignpro.com/efficiency): Combustion and thermal efficiency from flue gas O2/CO2 and stack temperature using the Siegert loss method.
- [Thermodynamic Property Calculator](https://burnerdesignpro.com/thermodynamic): Gas property and combustion stoichiometry calculations for thermal engineering.
- [Engineering Unit Converter](https://burnerdesignpro.com/unit-converter): Flow, pressure, temperature, viscosity and energy unit conversions per ISO 80000, ASTM D2161 and ISO 13443.

## Engineering Guides (Blog)
- [Hydrogen Blending in Natural Gas: How 20% H₂ Changes Wobbe Index, Flame Temperature and Air Demand](https://burnerdesignpro.com/blog/hydrogen-blending-natural-gas-combustion): What a 20% hydrogen blend does to Wobbe index, adiabatic flame temperature, flame speed and stoichiometric air — with worked numbers for a typical natural gas and links to free calculators.
- [CBAM Embedded Emissions: Calculating Direct Emissions from Fuel Combustion (2026 Definitive Regime)](https://burnerdesignpro.com/blog/cbam-embedded-emissions-calculation): CBAM entered its definitive regime on 1 January 2026. How to calculate direct embedded emissions from natural gas and other fuels with the standard calculation method — activity data, emission factors, oxidation factor, and a worked example.
- [Ammonia Co-Firing: Combustion Properties, the NOx Challenge, and What It Means for Burner Calculations](https://burnerdesignpro.com/blog/ammonia-co-firing-combustion-properties): Ammonia co-firing has been demonstrated at 20% ratio on a 1000 MW unit. What NH₃ does to flame temperature, flame speed, ignition range and NOx — and which combustion parameters you must recalculate before co-firing.
- [Excess Air Calculation for Combustion: Formula, O2 Chart and Worked Examples](https://burnerdesignpro.com/blog/excess-air-calculation-combustion-o2): How to calculate excess air ratio from flue gas O2 readings. Includes the lambda formula, O2-to-excess-air chart for natural gas, and step-by-step worked examples.
- [Wobbe Index Explained: The Key Number Behind Gas Interchangeability](https://burnerdesignpro.com/blog/wobbe-index-gas-interchangeability): What the Wobbe index is, how to calculate it per ISO 6976, typical values for natural gas, LPG and hydrogen, and why it decides whether a burner can accept a new gas.
- [How Thick Should Pipe Insulation Be? Selection Guide with Typical Thickness Table](https://burnerdesignpro.com/blog/pipe-insulation-thickness-guide): How to choose insulation thickness for hot pipes: economic thickness, personnel protection limits, typical k-values of mineral wool and calcium silicate, and a worked ASTM C680 example.
- [Orifice Plate Beta Ratio (β) Selection: d/D Trade-offs and Permanent Pressure Loss](https://burnerdesignpro.com/blog/orifice-plate-beta-ratio-selection): How to choose the orifice beta ratio per ISO 5167: the 0.2–0.75 validity range, permanent pressure loss vs beta, signal strength, and a sizing worked example.
- [Adiabatic Flame Temperature of 12 Common Fuels: Hydrogen, Methane, Propane Table](https://burnerdesignpro.com/blog/adiabatic-flame-temperature-of-common-fuels): Reference table of adiabatic flame temperatures in air for hydrogen, methane, propane, butane, CO, methanol and more — equilibrium values with dissociation, plus effects of excess air and preheat.
- [Combustion Efficiency vs Thermal Efficiency: Definitions, Formulas and Stack Loss](https://burnerdesignpro.com/blog/combustion-efficiency-vs-thermal-efficiency): The precise difference between combustion efficiency and thermal efficiency, how to calculate stack loss with the Siegert formula from flue gas O2/CO2 and temperature, and typical values for boilers.
- [Natural Gas Combustion Calculation: A Complete Guide for Engineers](https://burnerdesignpro.com/blog/natural-gas-combustion-calculation-guide): Master the fundamentals of natural gas combustion calculation with our step-by-step guide. Learn stoichiometric air, excess oxygen, and flue gas analysis per ISO 6976.
- [NOx Emission Reduction Strategies for Industrial Burners: 2026 Update](https://burnerdesignpro.com/blog/nox-emission-reduction-strategies): Explore proven NOx emission reduction strategies including low-NOx burners, flue gas recirculation, selective catalytic reduction, and compliance with EPA Method 19.
- [Adiabatic Flame Temperature: Theory, Calculation, and Engineering Applications](https://burnerdesignpro.com/blog/adiabatic-flame-temperature-explained): Understand adiabatic flame temperature calculation using NASA CEA data. Learn the difference between frozen and equilibrium conditions, and how to optimize your burner design.
- [Orifice Plate Flow Measurement per ISO 5167-1: Engineer's Reference](https://burnerdesignpro.com/blog/orifice-plate-flow-measurement-iso5167): A practical reference for orifice plate gas flow measurement following ISO 5167-1. Covers beta ratio selection, pressure tapping locations, discharge coefficient, and uncertainty analysis.
- [Industrial Thermal Insulation: Best Practices for Energy Savings and Safety](https://burnerdesignpro.com/blog/industrial-thermal-insulation-best-practices): A comprehensive guide to industrial furnace and pipe insulation selection, thickness calculation per ISO 12241 and ASTM C680, and realizing true energy cost savings.
